clauses.why: The verse says he called it Bashanhavothjair after his own name; "country" is fine, but "called it after his own name" is supported, so only the wording is tightened.
clauses.english: took all the country of Argob and called it after his own name
clauses.ukr: узяв всю Арґову околицю і назвав її своїм іменем
clauses.deu: nahm die ganze Gegend Argob und nannte sie nach seinem Namen
clauses.spa: tomó toda la tierra de Argob y la llamó de su nombre
